the weighted message passing algorithm is a simple and efficient method for community detection in heterogeneous stochastic block models with side information.

(1) we establish a connection between minimum energy on local neighborhood and misclassification error; (2) we develop an optimally-weighted message passing algorithm to estimate labels based on minimum energy flow and eigenvectors of the Markov transition matrix; (3) we prove that our algorithm achieves the optimal misclassification rate; (4) we provide an efficient algorithm for computing the optimal weight.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How can we optimally weigh the messages to minimize the misclassification error of the community detection in the general SBM?
the following two aspects: (1) how to optimally weight the message passing for community detection in the SBM; (2) how to optimise the minimum energy flow to reconstruct the labels for the SBM.
the following two problems: (i) how to optimally weight the message passing for community detection in SBM, and (ii) how to reconstruct labels in SBM with noisy or partial information.

the weighted minimum energy message passing algorithm is optimal for SBM with side information.
our algorithm is optimal among all the weighted message passing schemes for general SBM.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the weighted message passing algorithm can achieve the minimax optimal misclassification rate for general SBM, up to a logarithmic factor in the size of the graph.

we establish a connection between community detection with side information and minimum energy flow on a certain Markov chain and develop an algorithm to reconstruct labels based on the minimum flow and the eigendirections.
the minimum energy flow on the SBM can be efficiently computed via the eigenvectors and the weights of the message passing.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a proper weighting of messages in the local neighborhood can significantly improve the performance of community detection for SBM.
the misclassification rate of the SBM can be significantly improved by optimally weighting the messages in the message passing algorithm.
the misclassification error can be controlled by the minimum energy of the local neighborhood of each node, which depends on the underlying SBM and the label side information.
